nota: Teste de 18/11/2026: os mesmos 5 objectos do vocabulário do A1 no Nano Banana 2 Lite e no 2.1 (1K), para escolher o modelo das imagens genéricas (laboratório e vocabulário das aulas).
estilo: Clean, friendly flat illustration for an English-learning app: a single object centred on a plain white background, soft shadows, rounded shapes, limited palette with deep navy #000066 and golden yellow #FFC72C accents plus natural colours, consistent line weight, no outlines clutter.
regras: Do not include any text, letters, numbers, logos, brand names or watermarks anywhere in the image. One object only, fully visible, centred, generous white margin.
